title.narrative: Provision of Essential Health Services (PEHS)

description.narrative: The objective of the PEHSP project is to deliver low cost, high impact essential health services to about 1.8 million of the total population living in the former Upper Nile and Jonglei States. This particular project will focus on Fashoda and Manyo Counties and will target a catchment population of 100, 937 inhabitants.

The project will target to offer service to all populace of all gender and ages,male and female,boys and girls including the mostly vulnerable groups like persons with disabilities,elderly,refugees,returnees and internally displaced persons.The project will to collect and analyse data so that it can be disaggregated as much as possible by gender, age and any other social construct that inform programme decision-making and implementation.

UNICEF has published a Call for Expression of Interest to identify eligible Civil Society Organizations for prospective partnership with UNICEF South Sudan. Eligible Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) or Consortium of CSOs are invited to submit proposals for partnerships between UNICEF and qualified implementing partners (CSOs/Consortium of CSOs) to implement the PEHS (Provision of Essential Health Services Project) across 10 geographically distinct lots in the former states known as Jonglei and Upper Nile. Applications can be submitted as an individual entity, or in a consortium/partnership. Applicants are able to bid for no more than 2 Lots and will be required to demonstrate in their technical and management responses that the organization or consortium has the required technical, financial and management capacity to implement multiple Lot contracts.
This is another phase of Rapid result Health project (RRHP) funded by world bank through UNICEF where Cordaid has been implementing in Fashoda and Manyo. In this round, the call emphasizes partnership/Consortia advisable with the National NGO (not mandatory) so as the INGO can build the capacity of NNGO. Cordaid current present on ground implementing similar project and its plan to take a lead in consortia with NNGO for 2 lots will place Cordaid to better compete.
Currently, Upper Nile and Jonglei states are accessible and calm security wise. However, since the two states experienced heavy conflict with destruction and disruption that weakened the health system and structures; the budget allocation may not be adequate to restore complete health system and structure in the lots intended.

title.narrative: Climate Resilience

description.narrative: The integration of climate risks in programming includes an undertaking of concrete actions to reduce and/or mitigate risks related to climate change impact and disaster risks ( for example droughts, erosion, salinization, flooding, etc.) The projects we refer to could be on the themes of health education, justice, security, disaster management, finance and livelihoods.
